name: USB Wi-Fi Adapter for Wireless CarPlay
description: Runs the hotspot for wireless CarPlay on a TP-Link Archer T2U Nano or Nano AC600 (USB ID 2357:011e) in the USB port, for a head unit with no working built-in Wi-Fi. Replaces the Broadcom Wi-Fi driver with a Realtek one built for the unit's kernel; removing the mod restores it. Only for the cars listed. On the Santa Fe it is refused once HMG-API has seen the unit's Wi-Fi chip; on the Niro HMG-API can't tell a working chip from a dead one, so check the Car Report first (see the README). Turn ADB over USB off before plugging in the adapter, and pull the adapter before turning it back on.
